findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?via=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: page_to_text, list_clean, find_tool · Private data: agentrecord_lookup, list_clean, find_tool · Public sink: ground_truth_ask, countersign_stamp, agentrecord_lookup, list_clean, use_tool · Destructive: qr_code_make, launchpad_start, use_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: page_to_text, list_clean, find_tool · Private data: agentrecord_lookup, list_clean, find_tool · Public sink: ground_truth_ask, countersign_stamp, agentrecord_lookup, list_clean, use_tool · Destructive: qr_code_make, launchpad_start, use_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
